title: Gotrade Daily: After Nvidia Rally, Dell and Best Buy Report
summary: Wall Street had its best day since April 2025 after Huang's return to Nvidia. Tonight Dell, HPE and Best Buy test that rally.
body_markdown:
Options traders are pricing in a move of about 17% in either direction after the report,[according to TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/dell-stock-could-move-17-after-q3-earnings-say-options-traders) .


### HPE and Best Buy


**Hewlett Packard Enterprise ([HPE](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/hpe/) )** reported fiscal Q4 revenue of $14.55 billion, slightly above the $14.50 billion LSEG estimate. It guided to adjusted earnings of $1.30 to $1.40 per share for Q1, above the $1.07 FactSet estimate,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/23/stocks-moving-the-most-today-live-updates.html) . Even so, it traded 6.9% below Monday's close after hours.


**Best Buy ([BBY](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/bby/) )** reports Q3 results before the open,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/22/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) . The report lands in Thanksgiving week, ahead of the US holiday shopping season.


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


As of CNBC's 10:17 p.m. ET update on Monday, Dow and S&P 500 futures were up 0.2% each and Nasdaq 100 futures were marginally higher,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/23/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) . In Asia, Taiwan's benchmark rose more than 9% and South Korea's Kospi jumped more than 7%, led by Nvidia-related names such as TSMC and SK Hynix.


## Macro Note 📝


The Conference Board's November consumer confidence index is due at 10 a.m. ET, with a forecast of 92.1 after 91.7 in October,[according to Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/economic-calendar/cb-consumer-confidence-48) . On Wednesday at 8:30 a.m. ET, October PCE inflation and the second estimate of Q3 GDP are due, according to the[BEA schedule](https://www.bea.gov/news/schedule) .


## Conclusion


Monday's rally came after the Nasdaq lost 10% the week before. Tonight, results from Dell and Best Buy, plus consumer confidence data, test whether the rebound holds.


US markets are closed on Thursday for Thanksgiving and close early on Friday,[according to the NYSE](https://www.nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars) .
